description: 0xSero's DeepSeek V4 Flash REAP 162B (K144, 144 experts per layer, MXFP4, about 93.7 GB) on one Spark with vLLM, from 0xSero/deepseek-spark at 97fd6f02 (runtime/ configs and launcher; the vLLM Studio controller in the same repository is not packaged). Runs on upstream's public arm64 cutlass451-g27 vLLM image (pinned by digest) with upstream's GB10 REAP patcher applied at build time instead of at each start: router fallback for non-standard expert counts, per-layer MXFP4 memory hygiene, CUDA-IPC fix. 200000-token context, FP8 KV cache (fixed KV budget), one sequence, thinking on by default, DeepSeek V4 tokenizer, tool-call and reasoning parsers, CUDA graphs (FULL_AND_PIECEWISE), prefix caching. No speculative decoding (the k144-nospec-200k profile), larger KV budget and batch. Upstream publishes 200K-context sweeps for this profile in runtime/evidence; numbers are upstream claims and not repeated here. Licences are informational: weights repository and DeepSeek V4 are MIT; the source repository carries no licence file. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 beside the fixed 14G FP8 KV pool, as in 0xSero's runtime/configs/k144-nospec-200k.env at 97fd6f02 (lines 6 and 9); with a fixed pool the utilization is vLLM's startup free-memory check. The declared peak, 120,370,379,081 bytes, covers the weights, the pool and 8 GB of runtime overhead (116,721,706,080 bytes) and the tight teardown upstream records near its 8 GiB watchdog floor; the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash REAP 162B (K144) vLLM single Spark (0xSero)
